name: cold-black-dress-flash-portrait
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and nightlife editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create an 8K direct-flash fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman looking back over her left shoulder against a sharply detailed exposed brick wall.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long dark-brown straight-to-slightly-wavy hair parted in the middle, light complexion with natural freckles across cheeks and nose, light hazel-green eyes, defined lashes, natural pores and skin texture, dewy flash highlights, glossy brown-red lipstick, and a calm confident gaze. She wears a black matte form-fitting dress with an open-back design and one off-shoulder strap visible on the left arm, plus gold bangles, layered gold chain bracelets, and gold rings.
composition_elements: Subject stands with her back angled toward camera and looks back over the left shoulder; hands are held naturally near the waist.
Razor-sharp red-and-brown brickwork and mortar remain visible with no background blur.
A hard defined shadow of the subject is cast directly onto the brick wall behind her.
Keep the black dress, gold jewelry, freckles, and cool-neutral nightlife palette consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard direct on-camera flash with high contrast, bright specular highlights on cheekbones, forehead, and shoulder, cool-neutral color temperature, and a sharp defined wall shadow.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K RAW-style portrait, 35mm or 50mm full-frame prime lens, f/8 to f/11, ISO 100, 1/200s, deep focus edge-to-edge, sharp brick and subject textures, no bokeh, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 8K direct-flash fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman with long dark-brown straight-to-slightly-wavy hair parted in the middle, light complexion with natural freckles across cheeks and nose, light hazel-green eyes, defined lashes, visible pores and natural skin texture, dewy flash highlights and glossy brown-red lipstick. She wears a black matte form-fitting dress with an open-back design and one off-shoulder strap visible on the left arm, gold bangles, layered gold chain bracelets and gold rings. She stands against a sharply detailed exposed red-and-brown brick wall, looks back over her left shoulder toward the camera, and holds her hands naturally near her waist.
